description: STRTOK_TO_ARRAY(string [, delimiters]) tokenises into a VARIANT ARRAY of NON-EMPTY tokens: every character of the delimiters argument separates independently (the documented example treats both '.' and '@' as delimiters), the default delimiter is a space, consecutive delimiters produce no empty tokens, and a NULL string or a NULL delimiter yields NULL. Converted 1:1 from functions/StrtokToArrayTest (now retired); the ARRAY results are read through TO_JSON so the assertion lands on a VARCHAR no transport reformats.
